description: This file defines the ConvergenceException class, a specific exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that an iterative numerical process failed to converge.

classes.name: ConvergenceException
classes.description: An exception indicating failure to converge during a numerical computation.

methods.name: ConvergenceException
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a localized message indicating convergence failure.

methods.name: ConvergenceException(Localizable pattern, Object... args)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message pattern and arguments.
